viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, no bid shown. Check that it works and is safe (cord, switch, any 'as is' fault), shade cracks, whether the yellow is original or re-sprayed, and that the arm holds position. Sold prices in the last 3 years run A$79-368, mostly A$80-270, with the working and mint ones at the top and 'for restoration' ones at the bottom. Fairly steady, the highest sale was July 2026. Bulky but the arm folds, posting is awkward; local pickup or sell locally.
